response.description:
The following updates were made to Azure DevOps in March
2026.   
 The
     Remote MCP Server entered public preview, enabling seamless AI-powered
     integration with Azure DevOps without requiring a local server.  
 Security
     improvements included new Advanced Security PR status checks that
     integrate directly into branch policies, enhanced audit logging for secret
     push protection bypasses and security enablement changes, and the ability
     to export security overview data to CSV.  
 Azure
     Pipelines introduced improved deployment visibility through artifact
     tracking on pipeline runs and a new Stages view that provides clear,
     at-a-glance insight into what's deployed where across
     environments.   
 Teams also benefit from quality-of-life improvements
     including auto-complete PR defaults, condensed Kanban board views,
     cross-project work item linking in test results, and a doubled inherited
     process limit of 256.  Learn more.
response.title: Generally Available: Azure DevOps March 2026 updates
